latest.name: CATalyst v1.2.37
release_notes: Fixed Linux desktop startup packaging by bundling the Qt WebEngine backend and exercising packaged AppImage/deb desktop startup in Ubuntu CI.
Added Linux runtime dependency coverage for Qt/XCB and desktop notifications, including notify-send detection so the app does not claim notifications are enabled when Ubuntu cannot deliver them.
Added Spacescan API-key validation diagnostics for accepted/rejected/rate-limited/server-error probes without logging the key.
Routed macOS/Linux users away from the Windows-only automatic updater and toward manual release downloads.
Made the website prefer the Ubuntu .deb package as the primary Linux download while keeping AppImage available in release assets.
verification_notes: PR #112 unit tests, lint/security checks, CodeQL, Semgrep, and Gitleaks passed.
Ubuntu package smoke tests cover the Linux AppImage and .deb desktop startup path.
Website release metadata and download-link behavior checks passed.
